entities.summary: Pollachi is a town and municipality in Coimbatore district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the administrative headquarters of Pollachi taluk. It is situated near the center of the South Indian Peninsula, surrounded by Western Ghats. Agriculture and textile industries contribute heavily to the economy of the town and the town is a popular marketplace for jaggery, vegetables and cattle.
